data.name: Ashkit
data.gender_notes: Ashkit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ash means 'horse' in Sanskrit, and kit means 'warrior' or 'rider'. This name is derived from the Ashvins, the divine twin horse-deities in Hindu mythology. The name Ashkit carries the meaning “Horse or Warrior” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ashkit usually hope their child will grow to embody horse or warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ashkit belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Horse or Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashkit total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
